map.毛回报率 = 年租金 / 房产总价；净回报率 = (年租金 − 年持有成本)/房: Gross yield = annual rent / property price; net yield = (annual rent − annual holding cost)/property price; payback = 1 / net yield
map.基于租金回报模型：毛回报率仅按年租金，净回报率扣除持有成本（物业、税费、空置损失: Based on a rental-yield model: gross yield uses only annual rent; net yield deducts holding costs (property, tax, vacancy loss); payback is the reciprocal of net yield, for cross-comparing property investments.

map.毛回报率与净回报率的区别？: What is the difference between gross and net yield?
map.毛回报率=年租金/房价，未扣成本；净回报率在扣除物业费、取暖、折旧、维修等后得出: Gross yield = annual rent/price, no cost deducted; net yield deducts property fee, heating, depreciation, maintenance, etc., closer to real return.
